feature: Model-interpreted finite autonomous tasks; no fixed natural-language phrase parser or user-selected scan modes

change.target_sweeps: 0: semantic/compound goal; positive: stop after N successfully saved/restored complete surveys
change.counting: only complete survey increments scan counter; inspection/capture only consume action/byte budgets
change.model_role: interpret natural language and choose each next action using fresh bounded observations
change.controller_role: validate finite budgets/capabilities, mission tuning fence, freshness, per-action approval, storage, count and stop
change.restart: no automatic task/approval restoration; accepted unfinished identities remain unknown under existing rules
